name: Catalister
description: Product-listing automation for Shopify: research products and push thousands of listings into a store in minutes. Starter €14.99 / Stacker €24.99 / Scaler €34.99 / Slayer €59.99 per month, plus Enterprise. Targets e-commerce store owners and dropshippers. Founded Oct 2024, NL. Listed for sale at $300,000 (3.7x; first listed Feb 18, 2026).

mentions.evidence: ~$3,882 MRR, 100 active subscriptions, ~$6,572 L30, ~$264,810 all-time, ~65% L30 profit margin, ~1,528 visitors in L30. Revenue synced Oct 7, 2026 ~05:33 Warsaw (03:33 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Do listing automation for a marketplace with a painful API and a less flaky audience: wholesale distributor feeds into Allegro, BaseLinker or PrestaShop (CSV/XML supplier feeds → clean listings, price rules, stock sync). Wholesalers and real shops churn far less than dropshippers.

whyItPrints: Catalog grunt work: copying, cleaning and uploading products is the most hated job in a new store. It sits on Shopify's API and has ~65% margins. The flip side: MRR is down 13.6% in L30 and the dropshipping audience churns.
